parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm at about 65 bpm with a P wave before each narrow QRS, normal axis and R-wave progression, voltage below LVH criteria (SV1 + RV5 about 2.5 mV), no pathologic Q waves, and only slight concave J-point/ST elevation in V2–V4 consistent with a normal early-repolarization variant, which does not meet STEMI criteria.
